idea-plugin.name: CopyForLlm+
idea-plugin.description:
A fork of AykoSc/copyforllm that adds sensitive-file/folder exclusion.
Copies selected files and folders structure and content to the clipboard, formatted for easy pasting into Large Language Models (LLMs).
Features:
  • Generates a file tree of the selection relative to the project root.
  • Includes file content with language-specific comment headers showing project-relative paths.
  • Skips binary and empty file content but includes them in the tree/header.
  • Right-click a file or folder and choose "Exclude from Copy for LLM+" to leave its content out; the same entry puts it back.
  • Settings > Tools > CopyForLlm+: configure filename/path patterns (files or whole folders, e.g. ".env", "node_modules", "secrets") that stay visible in the tree but are noted as skipped and left out of the copied content.
Right-click on files/folders in the Project view and select "Copy for LLM+".
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0
  • Added an "Exclude from Copy for LLM+" entry to the Project view context menu, which adds the selected file's or folder's path to the exclusion patterns; on an already excluded selection it turns into "Include in Copy for LLM+".
  • Renamed the context menu entry and the settings page to "Copy for LLM+" / "CopyForLlm+".

1.1.0
  • Added a Settings > Tools > CopyForLlm page to configure exclusion patterns (files or whole folders, e.g. ".env", "node_modules", "secrets"). A match always stays visible in the tree; in the content section it's noted as skipped, but its content is never included.
  • ".env" and "node_modules" are excluded by default.
  • Fixed a bug where the tree only showed direct children of a selected folder, hiding anything nested deeper (e.g. selecting the whole project root wouldn't show files inside subfolders).

1.0.1
  • Added character count to clipboard copy notification.
  • Updated compatibility range.
  • Fixed internal API usage warning.

1.0.0
  • Initial release of CopyForLlm.
  • Copies selected file/folder structure and content to clipboard.
  • Formats output with tree structure and file content headers for LLMs.
  • Handles basic language comment styles.
  • Skips binary/empty files.
